newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario says 1995-96 deficit falls to C$8.726 bln.
newsitem.headline: Ontario says 1995-96 deficit falls to C$8.726 bln.

text.p: The Conservative government of Ontario, Canada's most populous province, said on Monday that it posted a budget deficit of C$8.726 billion for fiscal 1995-96 ended March 31.
The deficit figure was about C$372 million lower than the C$9.098 billion shortfall projected for 1995-96, Finance Minister Ernie Eves said in a statement.
The revised deficit number was included in the annual public accounts report released by the government today.
"The lower deficit is yet another indication that our plan to be cautious and prudent in developing our forecasts puts us on track to meet our fiscal targets," Eves said.
He said the government is on track to balance its budget by the end of fiscal 2000-01.
